Marie (partnerships): Quick check — Azure marketplace intake is asking for vendor attestation + SOC2 summary for the HW partner we're listing. Do we have a single artifact bundle we can hand them or is it multiple owners?
Jason (security): We have an internal SOC2 package (redactable) but the HW vendor has their own SOC + pen test report. Marketplace usually wants a consolidated artifact set and an attestation letter from us confirming we validated the partner.
Liam (ops): For Dedicated/Docker image listings we also need the SBOM and a pointer to where logs/telemetry are stored. Is that required at intake or post-approval?
Sara (legal): Marketplace asks for attestation that we handle customer data per contract and that we've reviewed partner controls. We need a brief attestation doc (one page) + contact for breach notifications. Can security draft?
Marie (partnerships): Thanks. Timeline: partner wants to go live next month. Need to pack this into the vendor onboarding zip. Ben, can you confirm the vendor will share redacted pen test pdf + SOC summary by EOW?
Ben (hw-si): Reached out to vendor. They have an external pen test from Q4 and a SOC2 TYPE II from last year. They said they can provide redacted copies and an ATO-style attestation doc. ETA Friday.
Jason (security): OK — once we get their reports we'll run our intake checklist. Two asks from my side: 1) confirm scope mapping (which services the SOC covers), 2) pen-test findings triage: if high/critical findings exist we block marketplace listing until mitigations or compensating controls are provided.
Marie (partnerships): Noted. How do we present scope mapping to marketplace? They sometimes get confused when a partner SOC covers only the hardware layer.
Jason (security): We provide a short matrix: artifact -> controls covered -> responsibility (vendor vs Redwood). Example: SOC2 CC6 (config mgmt) -> vendor -> covers hardware firmware; Redwood covers orchestration and customer data handling. Keep it 1 page.
Liam (ops): For the SBOM/third-party components, do we want to include a presigned S3 link in the bundle or a pointer to our compliance portal? Marketplace compliance prefers a direct artifact bundle (fewer clicks).
Sara (legal): Bundle + attestation is fine. We must ensure any PII in pen test screenshots is redacted. Also add a confidentiality clause header that says the artifacts are provided for review and not public redistribution.
Ben (hw-si): Will handle redaction. Can we get a template for the attestation header?
Marie (partnerships): I have last year's attestation we used for GCP. I'll paste a trimmed template here after this thread. Use it as a starting point.
audit-bot: Reminder: upload artifact set to /compliance/marketplace/3460012345 within 72h or this thread will be escalated.
Jason (security): Two procedural notes: please include a contact email for SOC reviewer and a TTL for how long we retain the vendor artifacts. We usually set 2 years for marketplace evidence.
Liam (ops): If vendor provides raw vuln scan output, we should sanitize it and only include a high-level summary + CVE list. Raw outputs often contain internal hostnames.
Marie (partnerships): Plan for next steps: Ben to upload redacted SOC + pen test by Fri -> Jason to triage + produce scope matrix -> Sara to draft attestation -> Marie packages + uploads to marketplace intake. Can we lock owners?
Ben (hw-si): Locking. I'll upload drafts to the compliance folder and ping here.
Jason (security): I'll try to triage within 48 hours of upload. If anything critical shows up, I'll call for a pause.
Sara (legal): I'll prepare the attestation template and run it by compliance before you finalize.
Marie (partnerships): Awesome. One ask to partnerships PMs: include the marketplace listing slug and the lead solution architect in the artifact metadata so marketplace knows which product this applies to.
Ben (hw-si): noted — will include slug and SA contact.
Marie (partnerships): Thanks everyone. If anything slips, I'll set up a quick call Thu afternoon. :thumbsup:
